Peter — appreciated. Quick checklist from our side so we can complete finance activation and begin sending POs:

- Final remit string we need in our system: "ACME / PO-<PO_NUM> / INV-<INV_NUM>" — confirm that will be accepted by your receivables team.

I'll also attach the Procurement PO template and the invoice-tagging guidance so the vendor-facing invoices map cleanly to PO numbers. Ben — once Peter returns proof, can Finance kick the micro-deposit and confirm the amounts here so we can close activation?

Best,
